name: hud_sensor_tracker_run_start_anims_from_zrd
description: HudSensorTracker::RunStartAnimsFromZrd skips in network mode, otherwise loads a ZRD start-animation list, resolves each listed zEffect animation entry, clears activation prerequisites, starts each resolved entry with zero velocity, and frees the loaded tree. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudSensorTracker mission-start and zEffect animation source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4192d0 validates the network-enabled early return, zReader::LoadNodeFromPath(path, 0, 0), missing-load zError::ReportOldNoOp path, named-node lookup, start-animation count as array[0]-1, animation name load from each child array index 1, FindEntryByName, ResetActivationPrereqCount, SetVelocity_Thunk(entry, 0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), and FreeLoadedTree cleanup.

The native smoke stages a mounted ZRD record with a START_ANIMS list, verifies network mode leaves entries untouched, then verifies non-network mode resets prerequisites and activates only the named existing effect animation entries with zero velocity while skipping a missing name.
